sop_entries.title: Location data request intake (synthetic SOP)
sop_entries.snippet: Location data requests (GPS, cell, Wi-Fi, semantic location) require a search warrant or equivalent court order and analyst review before any production step.

sop_entries.title: Subscriber information request intake (synthetic SOP)
sop_entries.snippet: Basic subscriber information may be requested by legal process; verify identifiers and requested period at intake.

sop_entries.title: Pen register / trap and trace handling (synthetic SOP)
sop_entries.snippet: Pen register and trap-and-trace orders are always SME-review matters; verify ex parte authorization, duration, and reporting cadence.

sop_entries.title: Non-disclosure and sealed matter handling (synthetic SOP)
sop_entries.snippet: Non-disclosure, sealed, and no-adverse-action requirements must be flagged at intake and enforced through the full request lifecycle.

sop_entries.title: Content production handling (synthetic SOP)
sop_entries.snippet: Content requests (email bodies, files, media, voice) carry high sensitivity and require SME-aware routing.

sop_entries.title: Overbroad scope assessment (synthetic SOP)
sop_entries.snippet: Requests spanning three or more product domains are presumptively overbroad and require SME scope review before any retrieval.
